name: mathews2004-dna
comment: DNA thermodynamic parameters from Mathews et al. 1999 (J Mol Biol 288:911-940), as distributed in ViennaRNA's dna_mathews2004.par. Extracted by scripts/generate_mathews2004_params.py.
